manifest.name: Single cluster: broker failure
manifest.description: RF=3, min.insync=2, acks=all. Broker b1 (leader of p0) is killed at 15s: producers time out until the controller fences b1 after broker.session.timeout.ms (9s) and elects a new leader from the ISR. b1 restarts at 35s, catches up and rejoins the ISR. No acknowledged data is lost.
